title: GTA VI took 13 years... and players are doing chores 😂 #shorts
description:
GTA VI finally launched after a 13-year wait, billed as the biggest entertainment launch in history. So what are players doing? Home repair, grocery shopping, trying to open a bank account... and birdwatching. 🐦

Source: The Guardian's roundup of reader and staff reactions.
Full story: https://pixelcontent.tech
